description: F-THREAD-STEP-01 — Golden round-trip of a ThreadFeature through STEP metadata. D8 (W8) STEP I/O regression fixture: feeds the feature in, expects the canonical blob back, then parses the blob and expects the original feature back. The blob is the JSON-encoded metadata block exactly as it appears inside the STEP AP242 PROPERTY_DEFINITION entity.
notes: Round-trip must produce a ThreadFeature object equal to the input (every field).
Blob is JSON-encoded — float precision is preserved exactly.
`derived` block is written by the serialiser and is informational; the parser still works without it (catalog lookup re-derives at parse time).
